title: System status and alert dispatch API with preview trigger
description: Implement api/alerts_router.py with POST /api/alerts/preview, POST /api/alerts/acknowledge, and GET /api/alerts/status to control and query alert stages directly from the web interface.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/alerts/preview accepts stage (1, 2, 3) and triggers a 3-second alert simulation
POST /api/alerts/acknowledge triggers snooze period on active alarm audio
GET /api/alerts/status returns active alert stage, snooze state, and mute configuration
Unit tests verify preview trigger and acknowledgment endpoints

steps.details: Create APIRouter(prefix='/api/alerts', tags=['alerts']) with schemas for PreviewAlertRequest and AcknowledgeRequest.
POST /preview calls AlertManager.preview_alert(stage) and returns success with active simulated stage.
POST /acknowledge activates snooze via AcknowledgmentManager; GET /status returns current active alert stage and audio status.
Create tests/test_api_alerts.py testing preview dispatch, snooze activation, and status responses.

technicalNotes: Validate that stage parameter is in [1, 2, 3].
Record all preview and acknowledgment actions into EventLogger.
